To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a sensitive and specific radio immunoassay method for the detection of serum myoglobin has been developed, and the results obtained from this method in the patients with various skeletal muscle disorders or myocardial infarctions are described.
radioimmuno assay of Mb was useful for early diagnosis of myocardial infarcion and for judging myolytic state in myopathic patients.

the radioimmunoassays developed for the measurement for human myoglobin (Mb) are highly sensitive and specific and can detect as little as.3 ng/ml of Mb and are unaffected by hemolysis, and that Mb levels could be measured in all normal subjects, and were markedly elevated in patients with muscular dystrophy and acute myocardial infarcation, and that the increase in Mb levels in myocardial infarctation was faster and peaked earlier than the increase in creatine kinase activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a radioimmunoassays for the measurement of human myoglobin in the serum and urine of patients with skeletal muscle and myocardial disorders.
the development of an assay system for human myoglobin (Mb) and its application in the diagnosis of myogenic myopathy and myocardial infarct.
the development of a radioimmunoassays for human myoglobin.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the radioimmunoassays of serum Mb is useful for detecting and judging the myolytive state of skeletal muscle disorders and for early detection and evaluation of acute myocardial injury.
radioimmuno assay of serum Mb is a useful tool in the diagnosis and management of patients with myogenic myopathie and in the detection of myocardial damage.
radioimmuno assay of Mb is a very useful tool for the early diagnosis of myocardial infraction, as well as for judging the myopathic state of myogenic disorders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
radioimmuno assay for human myoglobin has been established as a useful test for early diagnosis and monitoring of myocardial infraction and myogenic myopathie.
the radioimmunoassays for Mb are useful in detecting the myolytic activity in the skeletal muscle and myocardium and in early diagnosis of acute myocardial injury.
the serum myoglobin level is an excellent indicator of the extent of muscle necrosis and is an early marker of myocardial infraction.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the serum Mb level is a sensitive index for judging the myopathic process in skeletal muscle disorders, especially in Duchenne type muscular dystrophy, and for early diagnosis of myocardial infraction.
radioimmuno assay of Mb can be used for the diagnosis of myopathic conditions and for early detection and diagnosis of myocardial infraction.

the serum Mb level was increased in patients with myopathic disorders, especially in progressive muscular dystrophy and myocardial infarctions, and that the increase in Mb level preceded that of the serum CK activity and that the radioimmunoassays of serum Mb are a sensitive and useful test for detecting and evaluating myopathic disorders.
